comparison: Compared with each package's latest previously approved registry release. These notes describe the published 0.11.0 artifacts; adding notes does not replace their blobs.
commonChanges: Built for PlasmaEngine 0.11.0, Windows x64 Development, ABI win64-msvc19-0.11.0-abi6-dev.
Refreshed package SDK headers and import libraries from the release build; native packages require rebuilding project C++ code against this engine and these package versions.

changes: Migrated AI Behavior, Archetype and EQS Query asset windows to the engine UI, including consideration cards, score preview, behavior stacks and perception views.
Moved AI project settings and EQS preview controls to the engine UI; document changes continue to update the running engine preview.
Migrated the audio control collection editor and Amplitude project settings dialog to the engine UI.
Updated editor integration and packaged editor icons for the Qt-free editor.
Migrated the AngelScript asset document window to the engine UI.
Updated editor registration and packaged editor icons for the Qt-free editor.
First registry release of PlasmaAudio, an event-based audio package built on miniaudio with mixer buses, snapshots and DSP.
Includes clip, event, attenuation, mixer, music and bank authoring windows, waveform and event timeline views, auditioning and mixer console controls.
Includes packed audio banks, streaming, ADPCM and Opus codec support, loudness measurement and music playback.
Adds audio profiling, event logs, capture/debug views and platform audio configuration. The separate legacy plasma.miniaudio package remains available.
Migrated the C# project asset window to the engine UI.
Corrected component packaging so editor icons ship with assets and the DotNet tool payload is not duplicated.
First registry release of the Diversion source-control integration, using the local Diversion agent and CLI with sign-in managed by Diversion.
Adds Changes, Conflicts, History and Locks panels, file difference indicators and source-control actions.
Includes workspace status polling, branch/history queries, collaborator changes and project ignore-file support.
Ships the optional Diversion MCP companion alongside the editor plugin.
Rebuilt the Epic Online Services integration against EOS SDK 1.19.2.1.
Updated engine compatibility and native SDK payloads for 0.11.0; public package headers are unchanged from 1.0.6.
Rebuilt the fluid runtime and editor integration for engine 0.11.0.
Refreshed the native SDK payload; public package headers are unchanged from 0.2.0.
Migrated sound-bank and sound-event document windows to the engine UI, including their preview panels.
Moved FMOD project settings into an engine UI dialog and packaged editor icon resources for the new editor.
Rebuilt the game components runtime and editor integration for engine 0.11.0.

Migrated UI document, font and style editors to the engine UI, including canvas, hierarchy, palette, properties, bindings, states and animation panels.
Migrated Figma import and import-report dialogs to the engine UI.
Ships the engine-built GameUi runtime and import library so package consumers use the same implementation as the 0.11.0 editor.
Migrated collision-mesh and destructible-mesh asset windows to the engine UI.
Moved Jolt project settings and name prompts to native editor dialogs; refreshed the public SDK and Jolt include payload.
Migrated the Kraut tree editor and its document panels to the engine UI.
Fixed four malformed localized branch labels.
Removed the declaration of an absent Linux runtime component from this Windows release package.
Rebuilt MaterialX integration for engine 0.11.0.
Refreshed the native SDK payload; public package headers are unchanged from 0.1.8.
Replaced Qt networking and timers with nonblocking sockets polled by the engine editor UI runtime.
Streams GPU dump viewer files in chunks, limiting buffering when clients read slowly.
Keeps the server bound to loopback, uses exclusive port binding and protects connection handling during nested modal editor calls.
Migrated legacy sound, event and mixer editors to the engine UI, including event deck, timeline and mixer views.
Moved the legacy audio event resource implementation into this package so existing events continue to work after the engine-side implementation was removed.
Shuts down the audio preview service before unloading the editor DLL, fixing the shutdown deadlock caused by its device thread under the Windows loader lock.
Migrated the Modeling panel, brush marking menu and viewport mode/measurement overlays to the engine UI.
Preserves mode-sensitive controls, texture editing and undoable document edits in the new panel.
Includes the Modeling MCP companion DLL in the editor component.
Migrated the network profile asset window to the engine UI.
Updated replication property-row decoration and editor integration for the new property grid.
Rebuilt OpenXR integration for engine 0.11.0.
Refreshed the native SDK payload; public package headers are unchanged from 1.1.10.
Reworked the effect graph for the engine UI: system context stacks show blocks in execution order, with expand/collapse, enable toggles, drag reordering and undoable inline value editing.
Added typed operator wires and a graph compiler that folds constants, evaluates per-frame inputs once per simulation step and compiles per-particle expressions into runtime programs.
Added Set Attribute blocks in Initialize and Update, custom particle attributes and Kill If blocks; graph programs can read particle streams and sample gradients and curves.
Added per-particle wiring for drag, gravity factor, attraction force, scene-force influence, size-curve scale and gradient tint.
Added GPU execution of supported graph programs, including supported Set Attribute and Kill If updates, with explicit lowering diagnostics for unsupported graphs or block ordering.
Expanded particle events with velocity, color and size payloads, inherited values for event-driven spawning, and multiple named collision/death events.
Added event relationship information in the graph, warnings for unmatched event listeners and information about delayed GPU event delivery.
Added a live value spy with sample count, minimum/average/maximum, histogram and particle tinting; supported GPU values are read back with a delay.
Added deterministic preview timeline scrubbing and single-frame stepping by restarting and resimulating with a fixed seed.
Added preview motion modes and reporting for blackboard entries missing from the preview world.
Added conversion of legacy 1.3 logic blocks into operator graphs and attribute/kill blocks, with conversion notices and diagnostics for expressions that cannot compile.
Expanded particle runtime tests and CPU/GPU program reference coverage.
Migrated procedural graph asset windows and graph interaction to the engine UI.
Updated node-manager/editor integration and packaged icons for the Qt-free editor.
Rebuilt RenderDoc integration for engine 0.11.0.

Updated the package's editor integration and native SDK payload for engine 0.11.0.
Migrated sequence authoring to the engine UI, including scene viewport/tree, transport, binding outliner, track lanes, curve and event editors.
Introduced the engine UI sequence model and track view, retaining row selection while key-only changes repaint the timeline.
Migrated sequence render settings, preferences and thumbnail caching into the new editor integration.
Rebuilt the Steam integration against Steamworks SDK 1.65.
Updated engine compatibility and native SDK payloads for 0.11.0; public package headers are unchanged from 1.0.5.
Updated terrain editor integration to the Qt-free editor API.

Migrated USD Live panels and World Partition import to the engine UI, including prim selection, variant controls, validation and scan progress.
Moved stage reading and scanning onto workers for the nonmodal import dialog, which closes with its scene.
Updated USD property-grid integration and JSON handling for the Qt-free editor.

Corrected the editor component to include USD/TBB runtime DLLs, plugin resources and licenses, fixing missing-dependency load failures. Engine 0.11.0 also clears translation lookups before unloading plugins to avoid the USD shutdown crash.
